resources.string: RemoteDisplay uses accessibility to enable remote power controls and system navigation.
Lets ScreenTinker run as an unattended kiosk: silent updates, scheduled reboot, lock-task, and time/display control. Optional — the app works without it.
This panel is device owner: silent updates, reboot, kiosk lock-task, and time control are available.
Another app (an MDM/DPC) is the device owner, so ScreenTinker runs at Tier 0/1. The MDM owns updates and system control.
To unlock silent updates, reboot, kiosk, and time control, enroll this panel as device owner over ADB (fresh / factory-reset device, no accounts, USB debugging on):
Or scan the provisioning QR from the dashboard after a factory reset (tap the setup-wizard Welcome screen 6×). Device owner is optional — the app works fully without it.
